title: China Proposes Stricter Efficiency Standards for Solar Manufacturers
summary: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) has proposed stricter manufacturing standards for solar cells and modules, introducing minimum conversion efficiency requirements for different technologies and setting limits on energy consumption, water usage, and module degradation.
